description: This PHP test file defines a unit test class 'EmpUsTaxExemptionDaoTest' for testing the 'EmpUsTaxExemptionDao' data access object within the OrangeHRM system. It contains setup, multiple test cases for CRUD operations on employee US tax exemption data, and references external classes and configuration data.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDaoTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the EmpUsTaxExemptionDao data access object functionalities, including get, save, and update operations for employee US tax exemption records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating a DAO instance and populating test data from a YAML fixtures file.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving an employee's tax exemption returns expected default values.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Tests saving a new EmpUsTaxExemption object and verifies the saved values.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee tax exemption record and verifies the updated values.
